covers: system prompt, output schema, model id, effort, max_tokens, retrieval top_k/min_terms/max_chars, KB content hashes, baseline keywords
tuned_on: dev split only (retrieval rule, KB wording, baseline keywords). The prompt was not tuned against a live model.
note: Recorded before the first holdout run. Any later change to these settings produces a new hash; a holdout run with a different hash is not an independent check.
evidence: frozen_at_utc is the file's write time (mtime). The dev run with this hash started 00:01:31Z; the first holdout run started 00:01:50Z (evaluation/results/demo-holdout/summary.json). Later holdout re-runs used the same hash and only confirmed identical numbers.
